description: OpenAI has disclosed that an internal AI research model used funds from an unauthorised Ethereum testnet wallet while completing a coding assignment in June 2026. The model accessed the account through a publicly known recovery phrase and spent Sepolia ETH on transaction fees to deploy a smart contract. OpenAI discovered the behaviour during a September review and said the model had independently decided that using the funds was acceptable without obtaining permission.
title: OpenAI AI Model Used Another Wallet’s Ethereum Testnet Funds Without Authorisation, Report Says

description: In its advisory CIAD-2026-0049, titled ‘AI Agents as Attack Vectors’, CERT-In highlighted two categories of incidents involving the information and communication technology (ICT) infrastructure of Indian entities. The agency noted that some AI agents exceeded the boundaries of their authorised tasks during research and evaluation activities. CERT-In found that attackers were deliberately using publicly available AI tools to scan Indian systems and gain unauthorised access for financial gain.
title: CERT-in Issues Critical Warning After AI Agents Broke Into Indian Organisations' Live Systems

description: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 will launch in India in January 2027, a company executive has confirmed. The latest location tracker from Samsung was recently introduced in select markets, including South Korea and the US. Daill Kim, Samsung India's Head of Tablet, Note PC and Wearable, confirmed the India launch timeline through a post on LinkedIn.
title: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 India Launch Timeline Confirmed by Company Executive

description: Microsoft has announced the Xbox Nano controller, a portable and pocketable mini controller for Xbox consoles, PCs, mobile devices, and select smart TVs. The controller comes in a white colourway and features all standard gameplay inputs. It is priced $50 in the US and is scheduled for launch on November 4.
title: Microsoft Announces $50 Xbox Nano Controller, Launch Set for Next Month

description: Samsung Galaxy A38 5G is expected to launch with the same camera setup as its predecessor, according to a recent leak. The upcoming smartphone is tipped to feature a 50-megapixel primary rear camera, a 12-megapixel ultrawide shooter, a 5-megapixel macro sensor, and a 12-megapixel front camera. The Galaxy A38 5G is expected to debut alongside the Galaxy A58 5G next year.
title: Samsung Galaxy A38 5G Rear Camera Specifications Leaked; May Feature Same Sensors as Galaxy A37

description: Control Resonant has sold 1 million copies, Remedy Entertainment has announced. The game has now become the studio's fastest selling title of all time, overtaking Alan Wake 2. Control Resonant reached the sales milestone in just three weeks of launch. The game released on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on September 24.
title: Control Resonant Has Sold 1 Million Copies, Becoming Remedy's Fastest Selling Game Ever

description: The Vivo X500 series was launched in China in September, and its global launch is set to take place later this month. While the Chinese lineup comprises three models, a recent rumour suggests that not all of them will make it to the European markets. Only the Vivo X500 Pro and Pro Max models may debut. The leak also sheds light on their expected prices, RAM and storage configurations, and colour options.
title: Vivo X500 Pro, X500 Pro Max Price in Europe, Colour Options Revealed Ahead of Global Launch

description: YouTube has announced that it is rolling out labels for AI-generated content for the YouTube Music app. The labels have been integrated directly into the player interface, appearing above the player controls, below the name of the song. When a user clicks on the label, a pop-up will appear with the alert, “Made with AI. This audio was altered or fully generated using AI.” The company will use its proprietary AI detection tools to identify AI-generated music. Moreover, YouTube will work with its music partners to also flag AI-generated tracks. The audio and video streaming platform said that it will flag tracks with compositions and vocals created using generative AI models. The same labels for AI disclosure will also appear in the YouTube app for the same tracks.
title: YouTube Music Will Now Display Labels for AI-Generated Music Integrated into the Player

description: Redmi K100 is set to launch in China later this month. The launch date and key specifications are under wraps. Redmi has released a teaser image of the upcoming Redmi K100, offering a glimpse of its rear design. The Redmi K100 is now available for pre-reservation with a CNY 9.9 (roughly Rs. 140) deposit. Redmi K100 is tipped to feature a 6.9-inch OLED display, a Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset, and a 10,000mAh battery.
title: Redmi K100 Officially Confirmed to Launch Later This Month; Pre-Orders Begin

description: Ripple and Cross River Bank have partnered to integrate the RLUSD stablecoin into the bank’s Core Operating System, enabling fintech clients to move between US dollars and RLUSD through existing banking infrastructure. The service will use the XRP Ledger for blockchain transactions and connect with established payment rails. Cross River says the integration could support faster settlement, international transfers, and treasury management outside conventional banking hours.
title: Ripple Partners With Cross River to Integrate RLUSD Into Core Banking Platforms

description: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will be launched in India with the industry-first triple rear camera system, the company announced on Friday. The flagship Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will be India’s first phone to be equipped with a triple 200-megapixel camera system. The phone will get a Hasselblad-tuned camera unit, with a 200-megapixel (f/1.5) Ultra HDR Main shooter with a 1/1.3-inch ISOCELL HPC sensor, 24mm focal length, and optical image stabilisation (OIS). In India, the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will also feature a 200-megapixel Ultra-Sensing Ultra-Wide (f/2.2) camera with a 13mm focal length and autofocus. On the other hand, the standard Oppo Find X10 model is also confirmed to feature a Hasselblad-powered triple rear camera setup.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Confirmed to Launch in India as First Phone With a Triple 200-Megapixel Camera System

description: Meta on Thursday announced a new open-weight artificial intelligence (AI) model for coding, software development, and complex, multi-step tasks. The model, called Muse Spark Open, is said to have hundreds of billions of parameters and a context window that can handle large amounts of information. Meta has partnered with Apple to bring the model to Mac Studio desktops powered by the M5 Ultra chip. This, as per the company, allows developers to run agentic AI workflows directly on their machines.
title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open Model Brings 1M-Token Context Window, Agentic AI Workflows to Apple Mac Studio

description: Vivo is said to be preparing to expand its tablet lineup in global markets. An unannounced Vivo tablet, purportedly called the Vivo Pad FE, has been sighted in a certification database, hinting at its imminent debut. The purported device was previously also discovered on a European certification platform. A separate certification listing has also offered a glimpse of its charging capabilities. The Vivo Pad FE could support 15W wired charging.
title: Vivo Pad FE Reportedly Surfaces on TDRA, TUV Certifications; Charging Specifications Revealed

description: Apple’s artificial intelligence (AI) strategy aims to make the technology more useful for users rather than catering primarily to those seeking advanced AI capabilities. Apple marketing chief Greg Joswiak in a recent interview reportedly shared insights about Apple's AI approach and said the company is confident in its AI strategy, citing its integration of hardware, software, and services as a key advantage over competitors, including OpenAI.
title: Greg Joswiak Says Apple's AI Strategy Focuses on Everyday Users, Not AI Enthusiasts

description: Sony has launched its new Signature Series Walkman models, including NW-WM1ZM3, NW-WM1AM3, and NW-ZX900. The three new Sony Signature Series Walkman models are currently available for pre-order and will soon go on sale in select global markets via Sony-authorised retailers. The premium Sony Signature Series Walkman NW-WM1ZM3 model features a gold-plated oxygen-free copper (OFC) chassis, comprising a 99.99 percent (4N) purity OFC main chassis and an OFC rear chassis. The company claims that this allows the audio player to offer enhanced bass, soundstage, and high frequencies. It also gets Kimber Kable wiring.
title: Sony Signature Series Walkman Launched With Premium Design, Up to 40 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy S series and Galaxy A series phones will be refreshed next year with only new chipsets, according to a tipster. Along with the names of the phones, the leaker has shared the key specifications and features of the rumoured handsets. The Samsung Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+, Galaxy S27 Pro, and Galaxy S27 Ultra are expected to launch first. While their predecessors are powered by Samsung’s Exynos 2600 chipset, which is built on a 2nm process, the two new smartphones are expected to launch next year with the Exynos 2700 SoC. The rumoured Galaxy S27 Pro might also get the same chipset globally. The leaker claims that only the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will be powered by the new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series chipset. However, the two higher-end smartphones might launch with a 16-megapixel front-facing camera for selfies and video calls.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27, Galaxy A58 and More to Launch Next Year With Only New Chipsets, Tipster Claims

description: Amazon has introduced two new personal AI devices, Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse. The devices can convert conversations into summaries, reminders, to-do lists, and personalised insights. They also support integrations with Alexa+ and Amazon.com. Amazon Bee Frontier is priced at $74.99, while Bee Eclipse is priced at $99.99. Amazon Bee Eclipse features a magnetic design and is advertised to offer more than 21 days of battery life.
title: Amazon Bee Frontier, Bee Eclipse AI Devices Launched: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G will be launched in India on October 18. Further, the smartphone is confirmed to go on sale in the country in two colour options, namely Bold Black and Vivid Violet. It will be available for purchase via Flipkart. In terms of specifications, the Samsung Galaxy F70 5G is confirmed to be equipped with a triple rear camera system, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary camera with optical image stabilisation. It will also sport a 5-megapixel ultrawide camera and a 2-megapixel macro sensor on the back. The Galaxy F70 5G will be 7.5mm thick. It will also sport a 13-megapixel camera on the front for selfies and video calls.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G India Launch Date Confirmed, Key Specifications and Design Revealed

description: Bitcoin rebounded after briefly falling below $81,000, supported by easing Treasury yields and increased activity among large holders. However, more than $261 million in spot Bitcoin ETF outflows and hotter-than-expected US inflation have kept investors cautious. Markets are now watching Federal Reserve commentary and the October 27-28 policy meeting for clues about the next interest-rate move.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds From Three-Week Low as Whale Wallets Hit Record High

description: Apple recently underwent a leadership shake-up, with John Ternus taking over from Tim Cook as the Chief Executive Officer. Shortly after taking the reins, Ternus took to the stage during the company’s September event to unveil the first-ever foldable iPhone, dubbed the iPhone Duo. In a recent interview, the CEO spoke about Apple’s approach to product design, the development of its first foldable iPhone, and its evolving artificial intelligence (AI) strategy.
title: iPhone Duo Took Years of Work as Apple CEO John Ternus Explains Foldable Design Choices

description: Tecno Spark 50S 5G has been launched in India as the latest addition to the company’s Spark 50 lineup. The new smartphone is set to go on sale in the country on October 20 via Amazon. The Tecno Spark 50S 5G is offered in India in two colour options, namely Burgundy Red and Breeze Blue. The new Tecno Spark 50S 5G is a dual-SIM smartphone. The handset ships with Android 16. The Spark 50S 5G sports a 6.78-inch 6.78-inch LCD touchscreen. The display offers HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) resolution and up to a 120Hz refresh rate. It also features 260 ppi pixel density. The phone is powered by an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset, which is built on a 6nm process.
title: Tecno Spark 50S 5G Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: In the filing in US federal court in San Jose, California, OpenAI alleged the presentation happened months ago and that Apple is now making AI products of its own, citing the release of Apple's HomeView product this week. "OpenAI is very concerned that its trade secret and confidential information is now circulating inside Apple, where Apple engineers can shape Apple’s upcoming products based on OpenAI’s confidential and innovative work," OpenAI said in its filing.
title: OpenAI Lawsuit Says Employee Who Left for Apple Took Files About Unreleased Device

description: Rockstar Games has released the launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6, showing more of Jason's military past and some action-packed sequences from missions. The GTA 6 trailer also features a new original song from French electronic duo Justice, who has been confirmed as composer of the game's original score.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Launch Trailer Released, New Original Song and Composer Revealed

description: Apple launched its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, at its ‘Surprise and Shine’ event in September, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, new AirPods and Apple Watch models. While the other devices have already gone on sale, the company's first foldable iPhone has remained unavailable for purchase. That changes today, as Apple opens pre-orders for the iPhone Duo in India and several global markets.
title: iPhone Duo Pre-Orders in India Begin Today: Price, Offers and Specifications

description: Apple refreshed its smart home device portfolio with a new HomeView, which serves as a smart home hub, along with the Apple TV 4K (4th Generation) earlier this week. The Cupertino-based tech giant now appears to be preparing for another launch this month. According to a seasoned journalist, Apple plans to unveil its first touchscreen MacBooks, alongside refreshed Mac computers powered by its next-generation M-series processors. The next-generation iPad mini is also said to be on the cards.
title: Apple Reportedly Plans October Launch Experience for Touchscreen MacBooks, New iPad Mini
